modalLead: The tours, spotlights, and promo balloons are gone. In their place: a short quick-start card on first run, and a proper Tips & tricks section in Help.

items.text: Quick-start card replaces the wizard — first run now shows a compact three-step card (language & auto dark mode, layout, weather) followed by a short checklist (add a bookmark, tag one, open Config → General, see the keyboard cheat sheet). Skip or dismiss any time; progress is saved server-side per user, so it holds across devices.

Tips & tricks in Help — the rotating footer tips are retired. Config → Help now has a proper Tips & tricks section with 30 tips grouped by task (Everyday, Adding bookmarks, Editing and organising, Finding things, Keeping it healthy, Making it yours), picked up by the Help search filter and quick-links nav like any other section.

Every tour, spotlight, and promo balloon is gone — the onboarding wizard, the nine config-tab guided tours, the dashboard feature tour, and roughly twenty one-time discoverability balloons (search modes, G+jump, grid navigation, smart collections, inline edit, and more). Everything they taught is already in the keyboard cheat sheet (! or F1), in more detail. The :tour and :promo commands are gone with them.
Settings search promo stays — the one-time balloon that points at Search settings… on your first config visit is the only survivor; it no longer covers the tab bar.

Getting started describes the real flow — Help no longer sends you to buttons that don't exist any more; Getting started, Configuring, Search & toolbar, Workspace, Tags & collections, Inbox, and Finders are rewritten for the quick-start card and the removed tours, in all four languages.
Two missing translations filled in — the Help intro paragraph and the custom-themes info title are now translated in every language instead of falling back to English.
